title: Nudge dedupe must match the login that gh pr view returns for comments
answers: stack nudge comment posted again on every PR edit
duplicate stacked PR comments from github-actions
marker comment not detected so bot keeps commenting
body:
Symptom: Each `edited` event on a qualifying PR posts another stacked-PR nudge comment instead of only one.
Root cause: .github/workflows/stack-nudge.yml:nudge (step "Nudge", `already_nudged` jq filter) compares `.author.login == "github-actions"` and searches for the HTML marker `<!-- mlflow-stack-nudge -->`. That login form is what `gh pr view --json comments` returns (GraphQL author login). The REST comments API reports the same author as `github-actions[bot]`.
Fix pattern: When deduplicating bot comments read through `gh`, compare against the login that the same `gh` command returns, and keep the marker string identical between the search and the posted body.
Constraints: Applies to comments created with GITHUB_TOKEN. Reviewers verified the two interfaces differ; if the read path changes to REST, the login comparison must change to `github-actions[bot]`.
applies: Any duplicate-suppression logic in the workflow that reads PR comments with gh.
says: The automation posts duplicate stacked pull request comments every time a pull request is edited.
Editing a pull request triggers repeated bot reminder messages instead of detecting the existing comment.
Prevent repetitive stacked branch notices from spamming the pull request conversation on updates.
search: In .github/workflows/stack-nudge.yml, the already_nudged jq filter in step Nudge must compare .author.login against github-actions when deduplicating comments read via gh pr view --json comments. The gh command returns the GraphQL author login github-actions for comments created with GITHUB_TOKEN, unlike the REST comments API which reports github-actions[bot]. The duplicate-suppression filter must also search for the exact HTML marker <!-- mlflow-stack-nudge --> used in the posted comment body. If the workflow comment retrieval path changes from gh to the REST API, the author login comparison must be updated to github-actions[bot].
